Callout.Name: Threatening Calls
Callout.Advisory: No physical threat, calls logged, staff shaken.

Script.Line: He has called three times today. Same voice, same number.
He says he knows where I live and I believe him.
I want it written down. I want a reference number.

Lines.Approach: Nothing physical, but the calls are getting worse and the staff are frightened.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
